review.description: S6 report mutations release their controls on acknowledgement while shared saved updates complete separately. Uncertain evidence errors and per-report drafts remain visible, and later journal details win over earlier mutation reads.
review.implementation: Inspected ReportedIssues error separation, guarded direct mutation detail reads, coalesced list/subscription refreshes and selected-record request generations. Report submission, publication authority and idempotency remain unchanged.
review.tests: Read the uncertain evidence, delayed mutation/newer journal, selection race, continuous slow refresh and pagination assertions. The built UI test profiles Reports without filing a real issue or using credentials.
